title: Body, Epoch, Shell, and Altitude UI Selection Logic
negative_results: a parameter set without a declared CRS (frame) is refused (invariant 9)
a parameter set without an epoch is refused (invariant 9)
a frame not valid for the chosen body is refused (e.g. ITRF2020 on MARS)
an unknown codec or unknown height convention is refused
an out-of-range shell state is refused
an icosahedral codec without an explicit depth is refused (no hidden default)
a depth supplied to a non-depth codec, or an out-of-range depth, is refused

claims.statement: The body/frame/epoch/shell/altitude/codec/depth selection is validated into a typed AtlasParams, the allowed values for each field are enumerable, and default_params returns a fully-populated, inspectable set; validate_params fills nothing silently, so a signed receipt carries no hidden default. Validation is deterministic.
Selecting a parameter set declares the conventions a downstream codec will operate under and asserts nothing geographic about any source vector.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
